acceptanceCriteria: a single command bumps or verifies the plugin.json, marketplace.json and compatibility.json versions together
the host-package-versions-check failure message names that command
body:
The V1-1974 commit changed integrations/claude-code compatibility.json without bumping the plugin version. Only host-package-versions-check in the doc gates caught it, so a follow-up commit was needed (182e5cb63).
Expected: a cheap pre-commit or make target bumps or verifies the plugin, marketplace and compatibility versions together, or the check names the exact files to bump.
